title: He Hears My Whisper
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When troubles crowded all around
And I did not know how,
I called out to my Heavenly Father —
He heard me even now.

[Chorus]
He hears my voice, He hears my voice,
However small it be;
He bends His ear down close to hear,
And then He answers me.

[Verse 2]
I did not have to shout it loud
Or find the perfect word;
I only whispered, "Help me, please" —
And every word was heard.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
My sad turned into glad again,
My worried heart grew still;
So I will call on Him and love Him
All my life, I will.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So whisper what is on your heart,
Then close your eyes and rest;
You're never, ever, ever alone —
He hears you, little guest.

[Chorus]
mood: Listening music. Long quiet gaps between the phrases, so the song keeps stopping to hear something back — a child speaking into the dark and finding the dark is attentive. Soft felt piano, single slow chords with the pedal held, a few notes answering low in the left hand after each line. It starts unsteady and grows steadier, until by the last verse the answering has become the tune.
